patches.purpose: Use VOID_TYPE_P for typedef void returns and indirect function signatures.
Match actual host widths in labels, i64 constants, relocation addends, sizes and memory offsets.
Add opt-in SIMD128 machine modes and GCC RTL instruction patterns; disabled by default.
Match Basic C ABI singleton/empty aggregate arguments/results and narrow scalar extension.
Emit the five-argument external libatomic compare-exchange ABI without changing the builtin declaration.
Add SIMD scalar-count shifts, signed/unsigned and IEEE comparisons, conditional selection and fixed constant shuffles.
Use direct v128 values for enabled vectors and singleton aggregates; preserve vector register modes and aggregate storage.
Implement IEEE binary128 long double storage, soft-float operations and WASI two-i64 argument/indirect-result ABI independently of SIMD.
Enable signed/unsigned int128, WASI paired arguments/indirect results, scalar bitwise complement and SI runtime shift counts.
Ignore ABI-empty C++ records consistently during layout and generic O0 parameter setup without reading absent incoming data.
Use declared type alignment/storage units for named bitfields and classify singleton ABI values with the original declared storage type; preserve packed and unnamed-field rules.
Ignore unnamed bitfields when classifying singleton ABI values, preserve raw storage offsets, and retain empty aggregate storage modes without emitting an unused hard return local.
Add signed/unsigned i8x16 and i16x8 saturating add/subtract optabs and typed GCC target builtins with explicit SIMD feature gating.
Expose GNU __float128, exact Q/q literal typing, distinct C++ mangling, consistent same-format conversion ranks and GNU library feature detection over the qualified binary128 representation.
Add baseline SIMD conversion optabs and exactly typed saturation builtins, with composed packs/high halves and existing scalar fallbacks.
Install the documented 169-name SIMD128 header, typed direct lane operations and scalar/vector partial-copy legalization without changing the public vector ABI.
Define strong function/data aliases with shared addresses and independent symbol binding, visibility and relocations.
Normalize optional weak reference imports and asm-labelled symbol references, with typed weak target collection and strong-reference precedence.
Coalesce emitted C++ vague-linkage RTTI data through Wasm weak binding without enabling unsupported COMDAT aliases or weakening ordinary C definitions.
Qualify single-counter arc/test coverage with early unsupported profiling diagnostics and official libgcov normal-exit registration for WASI.
Emit genuine embedded DWARF4 through typed Wasm custom-section fixups and actual local/frame locations while preserving the default release path.
Add explicit opt-in relaxed SIMD target builtins, twenty distinct UNSPEC instructions and a separate typed intrinsic header; preserve baseline scalar and SIMD128 semantics.
Add opt-in naturally aligned native 1/2/4/8-byte atomic load/store/exchange/CAS/RMW and conservative sequentially consistent barriers; keep 16-byte operations as runtime calls.
Build real GNU libatomic with shared linear-memory locks for generic and 16-byte operations and an explicit alignment-aware lock-free policy.
Explicit static wasm32 local-exec TLS addressing, TLS data layout and C++ inline thread_local linkage; preserve default profile.
Port actual GNU thread-local destructor registration to per-instance TLS, using real allocation and explicit shared cleanup or ordered ordinary exit wrappers.

wabt.purpose: Assembler for GCC's annotated relocatable WAT; upstream WABT is insufficient

patches.purpose: Record actual SIMD instructions and v128 types, merge target_features and reject malformed or conflicting declarations.
Resolve strong symbol aliases and preserve independent linking names and relocation identities through annotated WAT and binary round trips.
Transport checked DWARF custom-section slots, code anchors and standard relocations, preserving opaque debug bytes only under verified readback layout.
Record actual atomic instructions/shared memory and bulk-memory operations; reject contradictory feature declarations.
Preserve static TLS symbols, segments and relocations, record their linking-ABI feature requirements, and support defined weak function aliases for inline TLS initializers.

wasiSdk.purpose: Native wasm-ld, WASI Preview 1 libc/CRT and compiler-rt builtins; never compiles user source
